tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: What printsi can print, where it delivers, and which operations exist. No credential needed.

tools.name: products_show
tools.description: Options, defaults, quantities and file requirements for one product.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Free preflight: checks a PDF against a product's print requirements and returns previews with issues marked. Creates no order and needs no address or payment; the file is stored for the check.

tools.name: address_validate
tools.description: Check a delivery address: the contiguous US + DC, or Hong Kong; no PO boxes or military addresses.

tools.name: pickup_points
tools.description: Pickup points (lockers, shops) near a street address, closest first, where the printer offers them.

tools.name: order_create
tools.description: Create an unpaid draft order with quotes: uploads and checks the PDF, validates the address and returns a quote per shipping method. Nothing is bought; use order_purchase for that.

tools.name: order_update
tools.description: Change an order's file, options, quantity, address, deadline or budget. Content changes re-check and re-quote.

tools.name: order_quote
tools.description: Get fresh quotes for the order as it stands (e.g. after quotes expired).

tools.name: order_purchase
tools.description: Request a purchase of a quote. Charges nothing: returns an approval link for the user to review and pay on Stripe's page. The card is held, and charged only once the printer accepts.

tools.name: order_show
tools.description: An order's status, spec, file check, address and quotes.

tools.name: order_list
tools.description: Orders you own, plus orders this machine holds tokens for.

tools.name: order_wait
tools.description: Wait until the order reaches a state. Exits 9 on timeout; call again to keep waiting.

tools.name: order_events
tools.description: The order's history: revisions, checks, quotes and status changes.

tools.name: order_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an unpaid order. A paid order has gone to the printer and can't be canceled.

tools.name: ticket_create
tools.description: File a support ticket when something went wrong (a check, an order, payment, or printsi itself). With --order, the order's history is attached. A person reads every ticket; replies go to the email that paid for the order.

tools.name: ticket_show
tools.description: A ticket's status, our replies and the resolution.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Send feedback about printsi: what worked, what didn't, what you wish it did. Goes straight to the people building it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check, ticket_create, ticket_list · Private data: capabilities, products_show, check, order_update, order_show, order_list, ticket_create · Public sink: ticket_create, feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check, ticket_create, ticket_list · Private data: capabilities, products_show, check, order_update, order_show, order_list, ticket_create · Public sink: ticket_create, feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
